environment: Windows Sandbox with networking disabled, run as SYSTEM
scope: MSI transactional setup, upgrade, injected-failure rollback and removal with HTTPS block page

fixtures.build: tools/build-msi-fixtures.ps1 with -d FaultInjection=1, WiX 5.0.2, agent and installer source at 81b8778

checks: fresh HTTPS install trusts its own managed root and serves TLS from the running service
upgrade without SERVER preserves identity, trust, hosts and running service
failed upgrade restores existing service and trust
failed removal restores private authority, trust, hosts and running service
successful removal restores original trust and hosts and removes service
notes: Each install waits about 2 minutes in Windows Installer software restriction policy checks of the unsigned fixtures; the install itself takes about 2 seconds

Four earlier attempts failed on harness defects (process wait, timeouts, root counting, identity source), not on agent or installer behaviour; their reports are kept locally in .venv/sandbox-acceptance/results
not_validated: Production MSI without fault injection installed on a real endpoint
Second-machine package with Chrome and Firefox acceptance
Real management server end-to-end policy changes
